name: nhatnguyet/terminology
title: Nhat Nguyet terminology: Vietnamese, Chinese and English names of calendar, Zi Wei Dou Shu, BaZi and numerology terms

heavenly-stem.description: The ten heavenly stems (thiên can, 天干).

earthly-branch.description: The twelve earthly branches (địa chi, 地支), also the twelve double hours.

sexagenary-cycle.description: The sixty stem-branch pairs (can chi, 干支) naming years, months, days and hours.

five-elements.description: The five elements or phases (ngũ hành, 五行).

yin-yang.description: Yin and yang (âm dương, 阴阳).

yin-yang-gender.description: Yin/yang of the birth year combined with gender, used to set the direction of Zi Wei and BaZi cycles.

zodiac-animal.description: The twelve zodiac animals (con giáp, 生肖). Vietnam's fourth animal is the Cat; elsewhere the Rabbit.

na-yin.description: The thirty na yin (nạp âm, 纳音) elements, one per pair of the sexagenary cycle.

solar-term.description: The 24 solar terms (tiết khí, 节气).

lunar-mansion.description: The 28 lunar mansions (Nhị Thập Bát Tú, 二十八宿) as assigned to days.

lunar-mansion-group.description: The four quadrants of seven mansions.

hour-spirit.description: The twelve spirits that preside over the double hours of a day (auspiciousHours); six of them make an hour auspicious (giờ hoàng đạo).

ziwei-palace.description: The twelve palaces of a Zi Wei Dou Shu (Tử Vi) chart.

ziwei-brightness.description: Brightness levels of the 14 major stars (miếu, vượng, đắc, bình, hãm).

ziwei-four-transformations.description: The Four Transformations (Tứ Hóa, 四化).

ziwei-bureau.description: The five element bureaus (cục, 局) of a Zi Wei chart.

ziwei-major-star.description: The 14 major stars (chính tinh, 主星).

ziwei-minor-star.description: Minor stars (phụ tinh, tạp diệu) placed by the library, including the 31 added in engine 2.1.0.

twelve-growth-stages.description: The twelve stages of the Tràng Sinh (长生) ring, used by both Zi Wei and BaZi.

ziwei-year-ring.description: The twelve stars of the Thái Tuế (太岁) ring.

ziwei-scholar-ring.description: The twelve stars of the Bác Sỹ (博士) ring.

ziwei-void.description: The two void markers Tuần (旬空) and Triệt (截空).

ziwei-yearly-star.description: Flowing (yearly) stars placed for a viewing year.

ziwei-pattern.description: Named chart patterns (cách cục, 格局) the library recognizes.

bazi-ten-god.description: The Ten Gods (thập thần, 十神) of BaZi.

bazi-hidden-stem-role.description: Roles of the stems hidden in a branch (tàng can, 藏干).

bazi-symbolic-star.description: Symbolic stars (thần sát, 神煞) the BaZi library looks up.

numerology-number.description: Names of the numerology numbers (Pythagorean method).

festival-category.description: Category codes of the Vietnamese festival dataset (le-hoi-viet-nam).

terms.definition_en: Spring begins; also the year boundary in Four Pillars astrology
terms.definition_vi: Bắt đầu mùa xuân, cũng là mốc sang năm mới trong Tứ Trụ
terms.definition_zh: 立春；也是八字命理中一年的分界
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 315°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Spring rain replaces snow as ice melts
terms.definition_vi: Mưa xuân thay cho tuyết, băng tan
terms.definition_zh: 春雨取代雪，冰开始融化
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 330°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Hibernating insects stir after winter
terms.definition_vi: Sâu bọ tỉnh giấc sau mùa đông
terms.definition_zh: 冬眠昆虫惊蛰
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 345°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Day and night are equal as the sun crosses the equator northward
terms.definition_vi: Ngày và đêm dài bằng nhau, mặt trời qua xích đạo lên bắc bán cầu
terms.definition_zh: 太阳北越赤道，昼夜等长
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 0°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Clear skies; the traditional Vietnamese grave-tending season
terms.definition_vi: Trời quang, tiết đi tảo mộ của người Việt
terms.definition_zh: 天气晴朗；越南传统的扫墓时节
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 15°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Rains that nourish newly sown grain
terms.definition_vi: Mưa rào nuôi ngũ cốc mới gieo
terms.definition_zh: 滋养新播谷物的雨水
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 30°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Summer begins
terms.definition_vi: Bắt đầu mùa hè
terms.definition_zh: 立夏
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 45°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Grain begins to fill out but is not yet ripe
terms.definition_vi: Hạt ngũ cốc bắt đầu mẩy nhưng chưa chín
terms.definition_zh: 谷粒渐满尚未成熟
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 60°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Grain forms ears; harvest season opens
terms.definition_vi: Lúa trổ bông, vào vụ gặt chiêm
terms.definition_zh: 谷穗抽齐，收获季开启
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 75°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Longest day of the year in the northern hemisphere
terms.definition_vi: Ngày dài nhất năm ở bắc bán cầu
terms.definition_zh: 北半球一年中白昼最长的一天
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 90°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Heat sets in but has not yet peaked
terms.definition_vi: Bắt đầu nóng nhưng chưa gay gắt nhất
terms.definition_zh: 暑气渐起，尚未到顶
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 105°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: The hottest stretch of the year
terms.definition_vi: Thời điểm nóng nhất trong năm
terms.definition_zh: 一年中最热的时段
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 120°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Autumn begins
terms.definition_vi: Bắt đầu mùa thu
terms.definition_zh: 立秋
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 135°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: The heat recedes
terms.definition_vi: Cái nóng lui dần
terms.definition_zh: 暑气渐退
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 150°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: White dew gathers at dawn as the air cools
terms.definition_vi: Sương trắng đọng buổi sớm, trời se lạnh
terms.definition_zh: 清晨气温转凉，白露凝结
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 165°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Day and night are equal as the sun crosses the equator southward
terms.definition_vi: Ngày và đêm dài bằng nhau, mặt trời qua xích đạo xuống nam bán cầu
terms.definition_zh: 太阳南越赤道，昼夜等长
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 180°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Cold dew; the chill becomes noticeable
terms.definition_vi: Sương lạnh, rét bắt đầu rõ
terms.definition_zh: 寒露；寒意渐显
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 195°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Frost appears in the highlands
terms.definition_vi: Sương muối xuất hiện ở vùng cao
terms.definition_zh: 高地出现霜冻
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 210°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Winter begins
terms.definition_vi: Bắt đầu mùa đông
terms.definition_zh: 立冬
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 225°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: First snows in the north
terms.definition_vi: Bắt đầu có tuyết ở phương bắc
terms.definition_zh: 北方初雪
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 240°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Heavy snowfall in the north
terms.definition_vi: Tuyết rơi dày ở phương bắc
terms.definition_zh: 北方大雪
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 255°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: Shortest day of the year in the northern hemisphere
terms.definition_vi: Ngày ngắn nhất năm ở bắc bán cầu
terms.definition_zh: 北半球一年中白昼最短的一天
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 270°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).

terms.definition_en: Deep cold sets in
terms.definition_vi: Bắt đầu rét đậm
terms.definition_zh: 严寒来临
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 285°. Sectional term (jie, 节): starts a BaZi month.

terms.definition_en: The coldest stretch of the year
terms.definition_vi: Thời điểm rét nhất trong năm
terms.definition_zh: 一年中最冷的一段
terms.note: Sun's apparent longitude 300°. Midpoint term (qi, 中气).
